        "description": "Screening endoscopy must be performed between Day -35 and Day -6 prior to Randomisation (Visit 2).",

        "then_events": [],
        "then_message": "Screening endoscopy date must be between 35 and 6 days prior to Visit 2 (Day -35 to Day -6).",
        "scope_form": "ENDO",
        "scope_events": ["V1"]
      },
      "item": null,
      "source_change_ids": ["CH-7"],
      "source_page": 34,
      "source_quote": "4. During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.",

        "then_action": "open_query",
        "then_events": [],
        "then_message": "Extended PK sample timepoint (48 h, 144 h, or 240 h) entered, but subject did not consent to the PK substudy at Randomisation.",
        "scope_form": "PK",
        "scope_events": ["V2", "V7", "V8"]
      },
      "item": null,
      "source_change_ids": ["CH-4", "CH-5", "CH-16"],
      "source_page": 26,
      "source_quote": "Randomisation will be stratified by prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in PK substudy (yes/no).",

      "rationale": "Under Option B, 48h, 144h, and 240h PK samples are recorded on parent visits V2, V7, and V8 instead of dynamic sub-visits; this edit check ensures they are only entered when PKSUB is Yes.",
      "uncertainty": ""
    }
